events: A group of warriors has to attack and subdue m_c when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/lose/loses} control and start tearing up the nursery.
A group of warriors just barely stops m_c from wandering out of camp.
m_c digs a hole in camp until {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws begin to bleed.
m_c stares up at the sun.
Drops of m_c's blood speckle the camp as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/amble/ambles} around mindlessly.
m_c growls at even the slightest noise.
r_c risks getting infected to groom m_c's matted fur while {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/sleep/sleeps}.
r_c begs m_c to recognise {PRONOUN/r_c/object}, but m_c doesn't react.
r_c has a dream that m_c's infection was cured. {PRONOUN/r_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/r_c/wake/wakes} up disappointed.
r_c tries to spend some time with m_c, but has to leave when m_c attacks {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
Every time r_c looks at m_c, {PRONOUN/r_c/subject} {VERB/r_c/feel/feels} sick.
r_c notices that m_c's empty spot in their nest is beginning to smell of infection, too.
r_c picks some flowers for m_c and leaves them at the medicine den. m_c locates the unfamiliar scent and destroys them.
r_c notices that m_c's absent wailing sounds vaguely like {PRONOUN/r_c/poss} name.
When r_c accidentally gets too close, m_c somehow stops {PRONOUN/m_c/self} from attacking.
m_c drags {PRONOUN/m_c/self} across camp, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} little legs too overcome with infection to work today.
When a Clanmate bats a moss-ball in m_c's direction, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} just {VERB/m_c/start/starts} absentmindedly chewing on it.
r_c has to wrestle a fresh rabbit out of m_c's jaws before {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/get/gets} it sick.
r_c fights off a snake to protect m_c, who doesn't notice and immediately attacks {PRONOUN/m_c/object} afterward.
m_c stalks r_c across camp.
r_c reinforces the walls on the undead den while m_c growls from the other side.
A group of warriors holds m_c back as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/try/tries} to attack r_c.
m_c chases r_c around camp.
m_c chases r_c up a tree.
m_c chases r_c so far into the woods that it takes {PRONOUN/r_c/object} all day to find {PRONOUN/r_c/poss} way home.
r_c tiptoes around camp as m_c watches from afar with malignant eyes.
